_about: Plain-language candidate letters. {placeholders} are filled by decide_candidates.py. Every letter that reports an outcome says that AI assisted, how to ask for a human review, and who to contact. Letters are drafts until the guardian releases the decision.
ai_notice: An AI system helped review your application. It looked only at your experience, certifications, skills and your application answers. Your name, address, age, gender, college and photo were removed before anything was assessed.
appeal: If you think we have this wrong, reply to this email or write to the hiring grievance officer at {grievance_contact} within 14 days. A recruiter who has not seen the AI's assessment will review your application again.
